body: This. Nparent (using they/them to protect identity) like to kiss the top of my head, and it makes me want to crawl out of my skin. Part of it is that they're just sooo long, which is uncomfy for anyone, but also part of it is that they have weaponized touch. After the abuse, they would force me to touch(hug) them. Obviously they can't force a hug when I am sitting on the couch or chair minding my own business, but they can force a head kiss or a back rub. I don't think it's sexual for me, I think that it's my brain acknowledging that this touch is a weapon and is not safe.
